Datasets are module attributes, lazy-loaded from parquet.

## Collections

| Module | Standard | Source | Datasets |
| --- | --- | --- | --: |
| `pharmadata.pharmaverseadam` | ADaM | pharmaverseadam | 30 |
| `pharmadata.pharmaversesdtm` | SDTM | pharmaversesdtm | 64 |
| `pharmadata.cdiscpilotadam` | ADaM | CDISC pilot | 12 |
| `pharmadata.cdiscpilotsdtm` | SDTM | CDISC pilot | 31 |

## Install

```bash
pip install pharmadata
```

## Usage

```{python}
import polars as pl
from pharmadata import pharmaverseadam as adam, pharmaversesdtm as sdtm
```

```{python}
adam.list_datasets()
adam.meta_tables()
adam.meta_columns()
adam.meta_specs()
adam_dict = adam.to_dict()
```

```{python}
adsl = adam.adsl
adsl_meta = adam.adsl_meta
adsl_meta.column_names
adsl_meta.column_labels
adsl_meta.column_names_to_labels
adsl_meta.number_rows
adsl_meta.number_columns
adsl_meta.file_label
adsl_meta.file_encoding
adsl.head()
```

## Format

```{python}
from pharmadata import set_output_pandas, set_output_polars, output_format
set_output_pandas()
dm = sdtm.dm
print(type(dm))
set_output_polars()
dm = sdtm.dm
print(type(dm))
```

`set_output_pandas()` / `set_output_polars()` switch globally; `output_format()`
is a context manager.

```{python}
with output_format("pandas"):
    adsl_pd = adam.adsl

print(type(adsl_pd))
```

## Validate by `pointblank`
```{python}
import pointblank as pb
# pb.validate_adam(adsl, "ADSL")
pb.validate_adam_structure(adsl, "ADSL")
```

## Polars Examples

```{python}
adsl.select(["STUDYID", "USUBJID", "AGE", "SEX", "TRT01A"]).head()
```

```{python}
adsl.filter((pl.col("AGE") >= 75) & (pl.col("SEX") == "F")).select(
    ["USUBJID", "AGE", "SEX", "TRT01A"]
).head()
```

```{python}
adsl.filter(pl.col("TRT01A") != "Screen Failure").group_by("TRT01A").agg(
    pl.col("AGE").mean().round(1).alias("mean_age"),
    pl.len().alias("n"),
).sort("TRT01A")
```

## Read parquet directly

- Dataset label in schema metadata
- Column labels in field metadata.

Both are bytes, decode to str

```{python}
from importlib import resources

import pyarrow.parquet as pq

path = resources.files("pharmadata") / "_data" / "pharmaverseadam" / "adsl.parquet"
schema = pq.ParquetFile(path).schema_arrow

print((schema.metadata or {}).get(b"label", b"").decode())
print({
    name: (schema.field(name).metadata or {}).get(b"label", b"").decode()
    for name in schema.names[:3]
})
```

```{python}
pl.from_arrow(pq.read_table(path, columns=schema.names[:6])).head(5)
```
